svg.title: Behind the code and my toolkit — pixel terminal
svg.desc: Aymane, full stack developer in Morocco. Building AI-powered web apps; exploring deep learning, computer vision and system design. Toolkit: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Docker and Linux.
